segments: Two black figures appear in a large white rectangle, with a red cross in the corner, indicating a hospital. The standing figure cuts the figure lying down and grabs the baby that emerges.
The baby moves out of the white rectangular, learning how to crawl and growing larger. He approaches a new rectangle and enters it.
The new rectangle has four desks and a teacher standing at the front. The main figure goes to sit at the empty desk and listens to the teacher talking.
The main figure puts his head down and the teacher hits him with a stick. He sits back up but soon puts his head down and gets hit again.
The other students salute but the main figure doesn't and a question mark appears over his head. The student in the front turns to him before being called on by the teacher.
Before the main figure can put his head down again, a bell rings. All the students file out, leaving the rectangle.
Yellow hats land on all four students and they enter a new rectangle with an instructor. They each walk up to a gun.
All the other students pick up the gun and put it over their shoulders, but the main figure doesn't and smokes a cigarette instead. The other students leave the rectangle.
The instructor approaches the main figure and takes his hat to put on his own head. The instructor grabs the main figure's gun, shoots upward, and then aims it at him.
The main figure starts doing pushups but quickly tires. The instructor stands there for a moment before leaving. A bird the instructor killed with his shot falls to the ground.
The main figure gets up and leaves the rectangle.
He enters a pink rectangle designed to look like a bar and sits facing a girl. She finishes her drink.
He gets drinks for both of them, and they both drink. He refills their drinks, and they drink again. The girl stands and takes his hand. The screen cuts to black.
